codeSystems.name: EvalStatusCS
codeSystems.title: Cicada Evaluation Status
codeSystems.description: Extension codes for dose evaluation status beyond the HL7 THO immunization-evaluation-dose-status CodeSystem. Only codes not covered by the standard are defined here.

codeSystems.name: IntervalReasonCS
codeSystems.title: Interval Reason
codeSystems.description: This value set includes codes for the reason an interval is considered to be invalid.

codeSystems.name: PreferredAllowedReasonCS
codeSystems.title: Reasons why certain doses are Preferred or Allowed doses
codeSystems.description: Reasons why certain doses are Preferred or Allowed doses

codeSystems.name: VaccineGenderCS
codeSystems.title: Vaccine Gender
codeSystems.description: Value set for gender categories relevant to vaccination data.

codeSystems.name: ValidAgeReasonCS
codeSystems.title: Valid Age Reason
codeSystems.description: Value set for reasons why a patient's age is considered valid/invalid for a vaccine.

codeSystems.name: CdsiObservationCodes
codeSystems.title: CDSI Observation Codes
codeSystems.description: Observations and Conditions that are important to indications or contraindications in vaccine forecasting

codeSystems.name: DataIntegrityCS
codeSystems.title: Cicada Data Integrity Code System
codeSystems.description: Records that cannot describe an administration. CDSi evaluates a vaccine dose administered and defines the assessment date as the current date, so these doses are excluded from evaluation and forecasting and reported in an OperationOutcome. They are statements about the data, never about the patient's immunity, which is why they are not evaluation statuses.

codeSystems.name: CicadaForecastReasonCS
codeSystems.title: Cicada Forecast Reason Code System
codeSystems.description: Why the engine forecast what it did. The ImmDS ForecastReason code system covers four of these; the rest have no ImmDS concept, and the ImmDS binding on ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.forecastReason is example strength, so they travel as a second coding rather than being dropped.

codeSystems.name: SeriesTypeCS
codeSystems.title: Series Type Code System
codeSystems.description: CDSi series type: whether a patient series is the routine schedule, one indicated by a risk condition, or evaluation-only. Mirrors the seriesType attribute of the CDSi antigen supporting data.

codeSystems.name: TargetDoseStatusCS
codeSystems.title: Target Dose Status Code System
codeSystems.description: CDSi Table 3-2. The status of the target dose an administered dose was evaluated against. R4 ImmunizationEvaluation carries only doseNumber, derived from this, so a skipped target dose and a satisfied one are otherwise indistinguishable.
